The line plot illustrates the trends of three distinct economic policy indices over time. The x-axis represents the years from 2016 to 2024, with tick labels spaced at irregular intervals. The y-axis on the left side is labeled "Index" and has a scale ranging from 0 to 1,000, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 100. The y-axis on the right side is also labeled "Index" but has a scale ranging from 0 to 9,000, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 1,000.

The plot features three lines: a black line representing "Wirtschaftspolitik insgesamt (linke Skala)", a blue line representing "Finanzpolitik (linke Skala)", and a purple line representing "Handelspolitik (rechte Skala)". The black line starts at approximately 50 in 2016 and ends at around 850 in 2024, with a notable peak of around 700 in 2020. The blue line begins at around 100 in 2016 and ends at approximately 800 in 2024, with a peak of around 600 in 2020. The purple line starts at nearly 0 in 2016 and ends at around 8,500 in 2024, with a significant spike to around 8,000 in 2024.
